requirement.architectural.name: MoneyIsExactMinorUnits
requirement.architectural.@statement: Monetary amounts are stored as exact integer minor units, never as floating point
requirement.architectural.@violation: A cent that disappears when a total is split three ways

requirement.architectural.name: Security
requirement.architectural.@statement: The system protects the data it holds and the actions it permits
requirement.architectural.@violation: A record readable by someone with no claim to it

requirement.architectural.name: Confidentiality
requirement.architectural.@statement: Stored data is unreadable to anyone without an authorised key or session
requirement.architectural.@violation: A database copy that reads in plain text

requirement.architectural.name: InvoiceTotalsAreEncryptedAtRest
requirement.architectural.@statement: Invoice monetary columns are encrypted at rest, in the primary store and in every backup
requirement.architectural.@violation: A restored backup that opens in a text editor

requirement.functional.name: Billing
requirement.functional.@statement: A customer is billed for what they bought and can see why

requirement.functional.name: InvoiceRecord
requirement.functional.@statement: An invoice records its own reference and total
requirement.functional.@violation: A charge with no invoice behind it

requirement.functional.name: ReferenceIsHumanReadable
requirement.functional.@statement: An invoice reference can be read down a phone line without ambiguity
requirement.functional.@violation: A reference where a support agent cannot tell O from 0

requirement.functional.name: TotalsCarryTheirCurrency
requirement.functional.@statement: An invoice total declares the currency it is denominated in
requirement.functional.@violation: Two totals in different currencies summed as one
